_about: ws.regulab Studio's card catalogue, brought to Semasa (Wan, 27 Sep 2026: 'make sure all ws.regulab studio features such render images and apply for all is brought to the new system'). ONE copy, read by the page (web/src/lib/cards/library.js) and the worker (backend/semasa/cards_library.py). Templates, their fields and hints are Studio's own (argus studio/part2.html CARD_TEMPLATES, cardPanel); the grounds are Wan's OneDrive photographs Studio kept as media g_* (label-01 left out: a US Nutrition Facts panel, never behind Malaysian regulatory copy); the poses are Studio's four mascots. Files live in web/public/cards/.

templates.name: Grid · Tajuk
templates.hint: Slaid pembuka. Tajuk, satu baris sokongan, baris sumber, maskot di kanan.
templates.hintEn: Opening slide. Headline, one supporting line, a source line, and the mascot on the right.

templates.name: Grid · Nombor
templates.hint: Gelap. Satu angka besar dengan unitnya, kemudian maksudnya.
templates.hintEn: Dark. One huge figure with its unit, then what it means.
templates.itemsEn: Line 1 the figure, line 2 its unit

templates.name: Grid · Palang
templates.hint: Palang perbandingan. Baris pertama warna aksen.
templates.hintEn: Comparison bars. The first row takes the accent.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Label | nombor | nilai dipapar
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Label | number | shown value

templates.name: Grid · Bernombor
templates.hint: Panel bernombor.
templates.hintEn: Numbered raised panels.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Tajuk | ayat di bawahnya
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Heading | the sentence under it

templates.name: Grid · Jadual
templates.hint: Gelap. Dibahagi garis putus-putus.
templates.hintEn: Dark. Divided by dashed rules.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Tanda | Tajuk | butiran
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Mark | Heading | detail

templates.name: Grid · Senarai semak
templates.hint: Panel senarai semak: setiap baris ada kotak tanda oren.
templates.hintEn: A checklist panel: every row gets an orange tick box.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Tajuk | ayat di bawahnya (pilihan)
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Heading | the sentence under it (optional)

templates.name: Grid · Mitos & fakta
templates.hint: Dua lajur bersebelahan: mitos (dipotong) dan fakta.
templates.hintEn: Two columns side by side: the myth (struck through) and the fact.

templates.name: Grid · Langkah
templates.hint: Garis masa menegak dengan bulatan bernombor.
templates.hintEn: A vertical timeline with numbered dots.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Langkah | apa berlaku
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Step | what happens

templates.name: ERA · Cangkuk
templates.hint: Slaid pembuka. Satu soalan besar, soalan-soalan lain terapung di sekelilingnya.
templates.hintEn: Opening slide. One big question, the questions it raises floating around it.
templates.items: Satu soalan terapung satu baris, hingga 3
templates.itemsEn: One floating question per line, up to 3
templates.leadEn: The second line, in a red block

templates.name: ERA · Penerang
templates.hint: Jalur tajuk merah, kemudian blok bertajuk marker.
templates.hintEn: Red heading band, then marker-headed blocks.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Tajuk | ayat di bawahnya
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Heading | the sentence under it

templates.name: ERA · Aliran
templates.hint: Rantaian langkah dengan anak panah; hasilnya dalam blok merah (nota).
templates.hintEn: A chain of steps with arrows; the outcome in a red block (the note).
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Langkah | apa berlaku
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Step | what happens
templates.noteEn: The outcome, in a red block

templates.name: ERA · Lawan
templates.hint: Dua angka bersemuka, senarai di bawah.
templates.hintEn: Two figures face to face, a list under them.
templates.items: Baris 1 dan 2: Label | Angka. Selebihnya jadi senarai.
templates.itemsEn: Lines 1 and 2: Label | Figure. The rest become the list under it.
templates.noteEn: The red line above the list

templates.name: ERA · Mitos & fakta
templates.hint: Mitos pada kertas, dipangkah merah; fakta dalam blok merah di bawahnya.
templates.hintEn: The myth on paper, struck through in red; the fact in a red block under it.
templates.noteEn: The closing line, in a red block

templates.name: ERA · Senarai semak
templates.hint: Nota kertas senget dengan kotak tanda merah.
templates.hintEn: Tipped paper notes with a red-ticked box.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Tajuk | ayat di bawahnya (pilihan)
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Heading | the sentence under it (optional)
templates.noteEn: The closing line, in a red block

templates.name: ERA · Angka
templates.hint: Satu angka merah yang besar, unitnya ditanda marker.
templates.hintEn: One huge red figure, its unit marked with the highlighter.
templates.itemsEn: Line 1 the figure, line 2 its unit
templates.noteEn: The closing line, in a red block

templates.name: ERA · Poster acara
templates.hint: Poster acara: label kecil, topik dalam kotak, tajuk dua berat (frasa *tebal*), penceramah dengan bulatan gambar, tarikh besar. Paling cantik atas latar cerah.
templates.hintEn: An event poster: a small label, the topic in a box, a two-weight headline (*bold* phrases), speakers with round picture slots, a big date. Best on a light background.
templates.items: Satu penceramah satu baris: Nama | Negara
templates.itemsEn: One speaker per line: Name | Country

templates.name: Foto · Tajuk
templates.hint: Gambar penuh, tajuk di bawah.
templates.hintEn: A full-bleed photograph with the headline low.

templates.name: Foto · Fakta
templates.hint: Fakta atas gambar, di tengah.
templates.hintEn: The fact over the photograph, centred.
templates.itemsEn: One point per line, up to 4

templates.name: Foto · Petikan
templates.hint: Satu baris yang patut dipetik.
templates.hintEn: A line worth quoting.

templates.name: Foto · Angka
templates.hint: Satu angka besar di atas gambar penuh, maksudnya di bawah.
templates.hintEn: One huge figure over a full-bleed photograph, what it means under it.
templates.itemsEn: Line 1 the figure, line 2 its unit

templates.name: Foto · Senarai
templates.hint: Panel kaca bernombor di atas gambar penuh.
templates.hintEn: Numbered glass panels over a full-bleed photograph.
templates.items: Satu baris satu: Tajuk | ayat di bawahnya (pilihan)
templates.itemsEn: One per line: Heading | the sentence under it (optional)

templates.name: Foto · Separuh
templates.hint: Gambar separuh atas, panel gelap di bawah dengan tajuk dan poin.
templates.hintEn: The photograph on the top half, a dark panel under it with the headline and points.
